恢复损坏的旧照片

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

步骤 1. 上传您的扫描件。您要恢复的照片。更高分辨率的扫描为模型提供了更多可处理的细节。适用于：褪色的照片、划痕和撕裂、折痕、黑白照片

步骤 2. 调整提示（可选）。恢复提示已预先加载并涵盖大部分损坏。修剪或扩展您的照片，例如保持黑白或重建大面积缺失区域。

步骤 3. 点击运行并下载。只需几个步骤即可恢复干净、锐利的图像。在工作流程中预览，然后下载。适用于：Photoshop·Lightroom·打印·任何编辑器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认设置（Lightning LoRA · 4 步骤 · CFG 1）是几乎每张照片的正确起点。

概述

该工作流程使用 Qwen Image Edit 2511（阿里巴巴 Qwen 团队的开放权重编辑模型）来恢复损坏的照片。 Qwen Image Edit 2511 是一个包含 200 亿个参数的模型，旨在通过编辑保持面部可识别性。它可以去除划痕、灰尘、颗粒和泪痕，同时保持拍摄对象的身份稳定，因此旧照片在返回时会变得干净，而不会改变某人的外貌。 Lightning LoRA 将恢复过程减少为 4 个步骤，因此您上传扫描、点击运行，然后在大约 36 秒内返回恢复的图像。无需设置，无需连接节点。

适用人群：希望在 ComfyUI 中修复 Qwen 2511 且无需从头开始设置模型和节点的创作者、档案管理员和摄影工作室。不适用于：保证一键修复。严重损坏的照片仍然需要及时调整和手工轻微修饰。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的扫描照片。更高分辨率的扫描为模型提供了更多的可用空间。

  2. 保留默认的恢复提示，或针对损坏进行调整（例如，保持黑白，或重建大的缺失区域）。运行它。

  3. 下载恢复的图像，准备在任何编辑器中完成。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每次恢复大约需要 36 秒。要知道的一个限制是：输出是强大的基础修复，并不总是最终的，因此严重损坏的照片可能需要随后手动进行轻微修饰。 Qwen 2511 已获得 Apache 2.0 许可，因此您的修复体可以用于商业用途。

使用案例

家庭和传家宝照片。修复起皱、褪色或撕裂的打印件，同时保持面孔可识别。

黑白到彩色。为旧的灰度照片添加自然色彩，或保持黑白。

档案和数字化。清理博物馆、图书馆或个人档案馆的扫描藏品。

工作室和修复服务。快速处理繁重的修复工作，然后手工完成棘手的地方。

Qwen Image Edit 2511 可以恢复什么？

Restore an old, damaged photo

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your scan. The photo you want to restore. A higher-resolution scan gives the model more detail to work with. Works great with: faded prints · scratches and tears · creases · black-and-white photos

Step 2. Adjust the prompt (optional). The restoration prompt is pre-loaded and covers most damage. Trim or extend it for your photo, like keeping it black and white or reconstructing large missing areas.

Step 3. Hit run and download. You get back a cleaned, sharpened image in a few steps. Preview it in the workflow, then download. Ready for: Photoshop · Lightroom · print · any editor

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (Lightning LoRA · 4 steps · CFG 1) are the right starting point for almost every photo.

Overview

This workflow restores damaged photographs using Qwen Image Edit 2511, an open-weight editing model from Alibaba's Qwen team. Qwen Image Edit 2511 is a 20-billion parameter model, built to keep faces recognizable through an edit. It removes scratches, dust, grain, and tears while holding the subject's identity steady, so old photos come back cleaned without changing what someone looked like. A Lightning LoRA cuts the restore to 4 steps, so you upload a scan, hit run, and get back a restored image in about 36 seconds. No setup, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: creators, archivists, and photo studios who want Qwen 2511 restoration in ComfyUI without setting up the model and nodes from scratch. Not for: a guaranteed one-click fix. Heavily damaged photos still need prompt tweaks and light touch-up by hand.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your scanned photo. Higher-resolution scans give the model more to work with.

  2. Keep the default restoration prompt, or adjust it for the damage (for example, keep it black and white, or reconstruct large missing areas). Run it.

  3. Download the restored image, ready for finishing in any editor.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each restore comes back in about 36 seconds. One limit to know: the output is a strong base restoration, not always a final one, so heavily damaged photos may need light touch-up by hand afterward. Qwen 2511 is Apache 2.0 licensed, so your restorations are yours to use commercially.

Use Cases

Family & Heirloom Photos. Repair creased, faded, or torn prints while keeping faces recognizable.

Black-and-White to Color. Add natural color to old grayscale photos, or keep them black and white.

Archives & Digitization. Clean up scanned collections for museums, libraries, or personal archives.

Studios & Restoration Services. Handle the heavy repair fast, then finish the tricky spots by hand.
